snippet.title: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey - Coming To Consoles Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Ten million years ago in Africa, survival is everything. In Panache Digital Games' third-person survival game, you lead a clan of early hominids, explore a dangerous world, and pass what you learn down through generations as you push your lineage forward.
